orders_or_contracts.statement: Material related party transactions with Messrs. Umiya Buildtek, Partnership firm, for a period of one year until the next AGM, with aggregate amount/value not exceeding Rs. 150 crores outstanding at end of any day.
The Company successfully obtained telecom regulatory clearances for all its products and has deepened its investment in Research & Development to enhance in-house capabilities.
The Project Operations segment continued to deliver consistent revenue streams, further bolstered by the addition of a new project at Pondicherry P-SWAN.

The Company received all requisite approvals, including RERA approval, and commenced construction of its project 'Umiya Bricklane' at Candolim, Goa, which has received an encouraging market response, evidenced by initial customer booking advances.

The associated firm Umiya Buildtek launched 'Umiya Prism' on Cunningham Road, Bengaluru, an ultra-luxury boutique residential project in the Central Business District (CBD). The project has received RERA approval, and initial development activities are underway.

During FY 2025-26, the Company recognized revenue of Rs. 468.65 lakhs for Q1 to Q3 under the BSNL WCL Project, based on BSNL's letter to continue services, and Rs.116.41 lakhs for Q4, based on the renewal service order issued by BSNL on 13th March 2026.

Foreign currency transactions recorded at exchange rate prevailing on date of transaction; monetary assets/liabilities translated at closing rates; exchange differences recognised in Statement of Profit and Loss except those regarded as adjustment to interest costs on foreign currency borrowings for qualifying assets which are capitalized.

Defined contribution retirement benefit plans recognised as expense when employees render service; defined benefit plans use projected unit credit method with actuarial valuations annually; remeasurement recognised in other comprehensive income.
Compensated absences not expected within 12 months recognised at actuarially determined liability; short-term compensated absences measured at undiscounted amount.
Long term Incentive Plans: retention and performance linked payouts accrued as services rendered or performance criteria met.
Equity-settled share-based payments measured at fair value at grant date, expensed straight-line over vesting period; estimates revised each reporting period.
Share-based payment awards of acquiree in business combination measured at market-based measure per Ind AS 102.

Current tax based on taxable profit using enacted/substantively enacted tax rates; deferred tax recognised on temporary differences using expected tax rates; MAT recognised as deferred tax asset when measurable and probable future benefit.

Property, plant and equipment at cost less accumulated depreciation/impairment; freehold land not depreciated; depreciation on straight-line method per Schedule II Companies Act 2013 except specific categories with different useful lives based on technical advice.
Investment property measured initially at cost, carried at cost; fair value based on independent valuer; gain/loss on disposal recognised in Statement of Profit and Loss.
Intangible assets with finite lives at cost less amortisation/impairment; internally-generated intangible assets recognised only if specific criteria met; research expenditure expensed.

Impairment: financial assets use expected credit losses (lifetime for contract assets/trade receivables); investments in subsidiaries reviewed annually; non-financial assets reviewed each period, recoverable amount = higher of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use.

outlook.statement: The Company intends to further enhance its capabilities in the design, development, manufacture and marketing of networking and communication products

The proposed change of name is intended to align the corporate identity of the Company with its present and future business strategy and to create a stronger brand association with its technology and networking business

The Company continues to focus on expansion of its technology and networking business, strengthening its research and development capabilities, new product introduction, execution of real estate projects, operational efficiencies and business diversification to drive sustainable long-term growth.

The management has adopted focused and aggressive business strategies in all spheres of functions to improve the turnover and profitability of the Company. Considering the present business scenario, the Company is expecting increase in revenue and profitability.

The company continues to closely monitor the finalization of the Central and State Rules and further Government clarifications and will record appropriate accounting adjustments as and when additional guidance becomes available.

The Company continues to invest in innovation, indigenous product development, manufacturing excellence and sustainable infrastructure, creating long-term value for customers, shareholders and society.

The Company also initiated the expansion of its dedicated R&D team to accelerate indigenous product development, enhance existing solutions and drive innovation across networking, telecom and emerging technologies.
